title: Terrain and props
description: Tactical terrain types and props (spec TAC-029, TAC-036, TAC-080, TAC-082).

moveCost.description: TAC-029, extra AP per tile (road, grass, mud, rubble, stairs)

material.description: TAC-036 / TAC-085, destructible material for cover

impassable.description: TAC-029: cannot be entered (rock, tree trunks, deep water)

obscuring.description: TAC-082: brush, trees, tall crops conceal

tables.description: TAC-080: tactical terrain tables (named by STR-095 tacticalTerrainTable) this terrain belongs to
